means: One constructed replay per Cave TSS to TST build board the planner can build: from an empty board, the terrain built out of pieces WE chose, then the page's own pieces, then the stood T into the cave, then the TST beside it. Run through the vendored Triangle engine. A board no demo stands on is published unbuilt with its reason.
not_eligible_because: constructed, not played: the queue, the hold and the key inputs are ours, and the terrain's pieces are ours too (harddrop draws it as garbage). No claim id, no badge, no figure in any count.
caveat: a demo stands only on what the planner can build from an empty board without clearing a line; harddrop draws this technique on a garbage terrain whose cell count no such build reaches.
rules: a demo starts from an empty board, as every decoder does; the terrain is an exact cover of its grey cells by pieces the planner chose, every one reachable from spawn by the engine's own moves, no line cleared
the page's own pieces are the build board's lower-case letters, one whole piece per letter
the stood T is the one T placement at which the corpus window (technique-facts.ts windowMatch, as drawn) matches the build board
the engine is the arbiter: every lock must land where the plan put it, with its spin, lines and hold flag

board.coords: y-UP: row 0 is the bottom row

unbuilt.reason: 地形（一格垃圾加一行窿喺第二格嘅垃圾）有 10 格，唔係 4 嘅倍數：要消過行先砌得出，而呢個 planner 唔消行（係 planner 嘅限制，唔係砌唔出）
L 搭咗喺窿上面嘅盤面有 14 格，唔係 4 嘅倍數：要消過行先砌得出，而呢個 planner 唔消行（係 planner 嘅限制，唔係砌唔出）
TSS 打完嘅殘局有 8 格，但用方塊鋪佢嘅每一個鋪法都要用一粒 T（成粒 L、T 剩低嗰三格同一格垃圾，量過），而 planner 嘅 T 留咗俾 T-spin，地形只用非 T 方塊（係 planner 發牌嘅限制，唔係砌唔出）
係 tss 上面打嘅 TSS：tss 砌唔到，所以呢幅都冇示範
圍住 TST 位砌好嘅疊有 39 格，係單數：每粒方塊加 4 格、每消一行減 10 格，由空盤砌出嚟嘅盤面格數一定係雙數，所以砌唔出
